blurb: Guests can take guided jet ski tours to see landmarks like Flowerpot Island and the Grotto or rent kayaks and stand up paddleboards to explore local shipwrecks. Jet ski tours require prepayment and a damage deposit, with provided wetsuits and life jackets. Kayak and SUP rentals are available on a first come, first served basis from May to September, with coaching for beginners.

checkin: We're looking forward to your reservation! Be sure to arrive prepared for changing weather. Weather on the lake is often cooler and breezier than on shore. Please note that we have a no refund, no cancellation policy. Please arrive 30 minutes prior to tour departure time. There will be no refunds for missed tours. No pets allowed on board. No outside food or beverages are permitted on board.
cancellation: Tobermory Cruise Line has a no refund, no cancellation policy. Refunds will not be issued for missed tours. Changes to tour date or time require advance notice. All tours are weather dependent. Tobermory Cruise Line reserves the right to cancel at any time, without notice, due to inclement weather conditions including, but not limited to, strong winds and/or thunderstorms.
